Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 21
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer prematurely concluded that the SFHIGHRISES/Robyn’s 2021 Market Stats page provided the definitive highest 2021 Mission Bay high-rise sale and marked the request satisfied. This relied on partial/segment-specific data (e.g., Q3 report or highest 2BD) and not the full-year, overall highest sale. They failed to cross-check broader 2021 records, resulting in the incorrect final answer of $2,950,000 instead of the correct $3,080,000.
